section_summary: This section records arrangements for visits by the Japanese Training Squadron, the transport SATA, and the training ship NIHON MARU to U.S. ports in 1936. It includes diplomatic notes, requests for customary courtesies, schedule changes, and replies from federal, state, and local authorities. It also covers a dispute over notification of the tanker ONDO’s changed itinerary and proposed calls and travel by the squadron’s officers.

subfiles.title: Courtesies for Japanese Training Squadron: New York
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for YAKUMO and IWATE during their planned U.S. port visits.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies for the squadron.

subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for YAKUMO and IWATE.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies for the squadron.

subfiles.title: Courtesies for Japanese Training Squadron: Navy
subfiles.about: Asks whether the Navy objects to the squadron’s visits and requests customary courtesies.
subfiles.summary: Seeks Navy concurrence and customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Courtesies for Japanese Training Squadron: War
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for YAKUMO and IWATE.
subfiles.summary: Requests customary courtesies for the squadron.

subfiles.title: Reply approving Training Squadron visits
subfiles.from: Secretary of State, signed by Wilbur J. Carr
subfiles.about: Approves the Training Squadron’s proposed U.S. port visits and reports requests for customary courtesies.
subfiles.summary: Lists the squadron’s itinerary and confirms that its U.S. port visits are agreeable to the State Department. Other federal departments and state governors have been contacted about courtesies.

subfiles.title: Japanese notice of transport SATA’s visits
subfiles.about: Requests approval and courtesies for SATA’s visits to Los Angeles and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Gives initial arrival dates of May 5 and May 20 and identifies Captain Masamichi Ikeuchi.

subfiles.title: Revised schedule for SATA
subfiles.about: Changes SATA’s Los Angeles visit to May 4–9 and Honolulu visit to May 19–23.
subfiles.summary: Requests prompt notice to U.S. authorities of revised dates.

subfiles.title: SATA courtesies: Navy
subfiles.about: Requests Navy courtesies for SATA’s revised visits to Los Angeles and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Confirms an April 30 telephone communication and requests customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: SATA courtesies: War
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for SATA’s revised port visits.
subfiles.summary: Confirms telephone notice and gives revised arrival dates.

subfiles.title: SATA courtesies: Agriculture
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for SATA’s revised port visits.
subfiles.summary: Confirms telephone notice and gives revised arrival dates.

subfiles.title: SATA courtesies: Labor
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for SATA’s revised port visits.
subfiles.summary: Confirms telephone notice and gives revised arrival dates.

subfiles.title: SATA courtesies: Interior
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for SATA’s revised port visits.
subfiles.summary: Confirms telephone notice and gives revised arrival dates.

subfiles.title: Reply approving SATA visits
subfiles.about: Acknowledges SATA’s changed dates and approves its Los Angeles and Honolulu visits.
subfiles.summary: Confirms approval and consultation with interested federal departments.

subfiles.title: Telegram to California about SATA
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for SATA’s May 4 arrival at Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: Asks California to extend usual courtesies during SATA’s five-day visit.

subfiles.title: Maryland governor’s reply on Training Squadron
subfiles.about: Reports referral of the Baltimore visit to Mayor Howard W. Jackson.
subfiles.summary: The governor has asked Baltimore’s mayor to arrange customary courtesies for the squadron.

subfiles.title: War Department arrangements for Training Squadron
subfiles.about: Reports instructions to Army commands to extend courtesies to YAKUMO and IWATE.
subfiles.summary: Army commands covering New York, Baltimore, California, the Canal Zone, and Hawaii have been notified; the Panama Canal governor is also to receive notice.

subfiles.title: Baltimore mayor’s harbor instructions
subfiles.from: Howard W. Jackson, Mayor of Baltimore
subfiles.about: Directs preparation for the squadron’s Baltimore visit and asks for vessel dimensions.
subfiles.summary: Instructs that harbor courtesies be arranged and requests vessel information for planning.

subfiles.title: Japanese response concerning ONDO notifications
subfiles.about: Disputes the assertion that ONDO’s changed Los Angeles and Hilo dates were not locally reported.
subfiles.summary: The ambassador says Japanese consuls notified authorities in Los Angeles and Honolulu of ONDO’s revised arrivals. Future changes will be sent through diplomatic channels when time permits, otherwise through local consuls.

subfiles.title: Request for Navy comment on ONDO note
subfiles.about: Forwards the ambassador’s ONDO explanation and requests Navy comment.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the Japanese note concerning notification of ONDO’s visits.

subfiles.title: SATA delayed at Los Angeles
subfiles.about: Reports SATA’s Los Angeles arrival has moved from May 4 to May 9.
subfiles.summary: Promises a further notice if Honolulu’s arrival date changes.

subfiles.title: Telegram updating California on SATA
subfiles.about: Advises California that SATA is now due at Los Angeles on May 9.
subfiles.summary: Updates the earlier May 4 arrival notice.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of SATA delay
subfiles.about: Acknowledges SATA’s new Los Angeles date and confirms notice to authorities.
subfiles.summary: Federal and state authorities have been advised of the May 9 arrival.

subfiles.title: War Department reply on SATA
subfiles.about: Reports Army instructions to extend customary courtesies to SATA in California and Hawaii.
subfiles.summary: Confirms radiogram and cablegram instructions to the relevant Army commands.

subfiles.title: Customs courtesies for Training Squadron officers
subfiles.about: Requests customs courtesies for officers making brief trips to Vancouver, Ensenada, and Ottawa.
subfiles.summary: Names Vice Admiral Zengo Yoshida and Captains Toshihisa Nakamura and Kakuji Tsunoda among officers who will cross U.S. borders without passports.

subfiles.title: Protocol memorandum to Visa Division
subfiles.about: Refers the officers’ travel request for consideration of visa waivers.
subfiles.summary: Requests a decision on reentry without visas.

subfiles.title: Visa Division referral to Mr. Coulter
subfiles.about: Refers the officers’ brief border trips for consideration of visa waivers.
subfiles.summary: Requests action on passportless reentry.

subfiles.title: Waiver of passport and visa requirements
subfiles.about: Waives passport and visa requirements for squadron officers returning from Canada and Mexico.
subfiles.summary: Explains the planned Vancouver, Ensenada, and Ottawa trips. The State Department permits the officers to reenter the United States to rejoin their vessels and offers to obtain the unnamed officers’ identities if needed.

subfiles.title: Customs Bureau cover letter on SATA
subfiles.from: George W. Ashworth, Bureau of Customs
subfiles.to: Assistant Chief, Division of Protocol and Conferences
subfiles.about: Reports customs authorization for courtesies to SATA at Los Angeles and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Encloses instructions to both customs collectors.

subfiles.title: Customs telegram to Los Angeles
subfiles.about: Authorizes customary courtesies for SATA’s oil-loading visit.
subfiles.summary: Instructs the collector to extend courtesies.

subfiles.title: Customs letter to Honolulu
subfiles.about: Authorizes customary courtesies for SATA’s replenishment visit.
subfiles.summary: Instructs the collector to extend courtesies.

subfiles.title: Navy acceptance of Training Squadron visits
subfiles.about: States that the Navy does not object to the visits of YAKUMO and IWATE.
subfiles.summary: The Navy will direct local commanders to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: New York governor’s reply
subfiles.about: Confirms courtesies for the squadron’s New York visit.
subfiles.summary: Promises customary facilities and courtesies for the August 25–September 2 visit.

subfiles.title: Washington governor’s reply
subfiles.about: Confirms courtesies during the squadron’s Washington state visit.
subfiles.summary: Promises courtesies for the June 30–July 6 visit.

subfiles.title: Request for presidential reception and review
subfiles.about: Requests a presidential meeting for Admiral Yoshida’s party and review of officers and midshipmen.
subfiles.summary: Proposes a meeting and review on August 19.

subfiles.title: State Department letter to White House
subfiles.about: Refers Japan’s request for a presidential meeting and review of the squadron.
subfiles.summary: Hull notes the President’s limited availability and doubts a review would be arranged. He cites receptions of earlier Japanese squadron commanders by Presidents Coolidge and Hoover and says the ambassador has been told the request will be considered later.

subfiles.title: Reply to Japanese ambassador on presidential request
subfiles.from: Secretary of State, signed by William Phillips
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the request for a presidential meeting and review.
subfiles.summary: Explains that appointments cannot be fixed so far ahead and that the White House will consider the matter later.

subfiles.title: California governor’s reply on YAKUMO and IWATE
subfiles.about: Promises customary courtesies to the squadron’s commanders in California.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges planned calls at San Francisco and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: California governor’s reply on SATA
subfiles.about: Acknowledges notice of SATA’s arrival and confirms customary courtesies.
subfiles.summary: Says state and city authorities welcome visiting ships.

subfiles.title: Japanese requests for Baltimore arrangements
subfiles.about: Requests official calls, adjacent berths, coaling access, pilots, and harbor-entry guidance for the squadron.
subfiles.summary: Admiral Yoshida seeks calls on State and Navy officials during the Baltimore visit. The note asks for nearby berths suited to coaling, pilots for arrival and departure, guidance on local official calls, and an answer about sanitary inspection.

subfiles.title: Reply on Baltimore arrangements
subfiles.about: Refers Baltimore arrangements to the Navy and offers an August 19 State Department reception.
subfiles.summary: The Navy is expected to arrange details directly with the Japanese naval attaché. The Secretary or Acting Secretary will receive Admiral Yoshida’s party at a time to be set.

subfiles.title: Referral of Baltimore requests to Navy
subfiles.about: Forwards Japan’s Baltimore requests for Navy action.
subfiles.summary: Suggests direct coordination with the Japanese naval attaché and notes State’s willingness to receive Admiral Yoshida’s party.

subfiles.title: SATA delayed at Honolulu
subfiles.about: Reports SATA is now expected at Honolulu on May 24.
subfiles.summary: Updates the earlier Honolulu schedule.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Honolulu delay
subfiles.about: Acknowledges SATA’s new Honolulu arrival date and confirms federal notification.
subfiles.summary: States that interested federal authorities have been advised.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for NIHON MARU visits
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for NIHON MARU at three Hawaiian ports in June.
subfiles.summary: Gives the ship’s route through Kahului, Kealakekua, and Kailua, notes possible weather delays, and identifies Captain Gyoshun Nagata and the personnel aboard.

subfiles.title: NIHON MARU courtesies: Navy
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for NIHON MARU’s Hawaiian port calls.
subfiles.summary: Provides the June itinerary and personnel details.

subfiles.title: NIHON MARU courtesies: Agriculture

subfiles.summary: Provides the June itinerary and personnel details.

subfiles.title: NIHON MARU courtesies: Interior
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for NIHON MARU’s Hawaiian port calls.
subfiles.summary: Provides the June itinerary and personnel details.

subfiles.title: Reply approving NIHON MARU visits
subfiles.about: Approves NIHON MARU’s Hawaiian visits and addresses possible weather-related schedule changes.
subfiles.summary: Confirms that the proposed visits are agreeable and that federal departments have been asked to extend customary courtesies. The State Department understands that weather would affect the schedule only by delaying arrivals.
